properties.name: MEASURED on 0.87.0: reflow2 reads an attack graph the way Dung's GROUNDED semantics does. Reinstatement works (C attacks B, which attacks A: C holds, B fails, A holds with B's objection "answered"). Mutual attack and a three-way cycle all stay undecided ("contested"), but reflow2 names neither the two credulous choices of a mutual attack nor the paradox of an odd cycle, and detect_defects lists every attack as a structural contradiction
properties.source: measured by Claude in Anthony's hub session 2026-10-18, on the published reflow2 0.87.0 binary in a scratch store, after he described Dung's argumentation frameworks (reinstatement, mutual attack, cycles)
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-10-18, published reflow2 0.87.0 (sha256 45c1a13d…), scratch store. Each argument is a proposition taken as given; each attack is an opposing CONTRADICTS. Read with reasoning_report per claim.
1. CHAIN (Anthony's factory example): C (the whistleblower) → B (the corporate report) → A (fine the factory).
   - C: truth holds (unattacked).
   - B: fails, "refuted by req:c, which holds".
   - A: HOLDS, with objection B reading "answered", truth fails.
   That is REINSTATEMENT, matching Dung's grounded extension {A, C}.
   - propagate_from on C reaches B (distance 1) and A (distance 2) but shows no verdicts for them (B springing back, A falling is not stated).
2. MUTUAL ATTACK: X ↔ Y. Both read truth unknown, "contested: … neither established nor answered".
   This matches GROUNDED semantics (both undecided). reflow2 does NOT say that the PREFERRED and STABLE semantics give two consistent choices, {X} or {Y}.
3. ODD CYCLE: P → Q → S → P. All three read unknown, contested.
   This matches grounded, and matches preferred (the empty extension). reflow2 does NOT say that an odd cycle has NO stable extension (a paradox), as distinct from an even cycle's choice.
4. detect_defects lists every one of the 7 attacks as "'x' and 'y' contradict each other" (structural defects), including the accepted, settled reinstatement in case 1.
   This is what req:a-correct-proof-reads-correct-assumptions-objections-and-conditional-claims (item 2) fixes, in build phase 1.
THIS ANSWERS idea (e) of dec:idea-what-reflow2-takes-from-the-argumentation-frameworks ("not yet measured what reflow2's recursive evaluation does with such a cycle"): reflow2 is skeptical (grounded). What is missing is naming the credulous alternatives and odd-cycle paradoxes. It is observation only; no option is chosen.
